title: IBM logos / Rebus

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Separate expressive heritage from the official signature, so a playful familiar motif adds character without confusing the identity’s formal role.
strategic_value: The eye-bee-M and vertical totem can extend IBM’s recognizable heritage into merchandise, events and environments while preserving the 8-bar’s authority.
demonstration: Horizontal, vertical and classic rebus specimens lead into color pairs, clear-space and misuse diagrams, approved repeat patterns and applied examples.
practical_value: Choose the rebus for a permitted expressive context while retaining the 8-bar for official sign-offs.

content_islands.name: Origin and current rebus
content_islands.spec: Begin with the historical introduction and resource card, then large positive and reversed horizontal specimens.

content_islands.name: Totem and classic variant
content_islands.spec: Compare vertical totems and their grid relationship before showing the restricted historic color treatment on black.

content_islands.name: Color and isolation
content_islands.spec: Arrange core-color pairings above the M-height clear-space diagram.

content_islands.name: Misuse and patterns
content_islands.spec: Contrast prohibited rearrangements and sign-off uses with approved repeat patterns.

content_islands.name: Applied heritage
content_islands.spec: Close with merchandise and environmental examples including a notebook, shirt and large vertical display.

ingredient.name: IBM rebus
ingredient.role: Express heritage and human character in special applications.
ingredient.application: Use the approved positive, reversed or totem artwork with isolation equal to the M height; retain the 8-bar for official communication sign-offs.
ingredient.scope: Special applications such as merchandise, badges and events. The classic historic color artwork is restricted to heritage merchandise or approved occasions, requires prior approval and must use a black background.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains the totem as a human connection between mankind and machines and connects pattern uses to practical settings.
reference_purposes.Expression: Horizontal and vertical rebuses, patterns and merchandise demonstrate IBM’s heritage vocabulary.
reference_purposes.Application: The page shows positive/reversed versions, background pairings, clear space and applications.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The rebus cannot replace the 8-bar sign-off; the classic color version requires permission and a black background, and its colors are not the current standard palette.
